def factor_simplified_size_adaptive_value_v2(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    large = df_copy['style_gate_size_large'].astype(bool)
    small = df_copy['style_gate_size_small'].astype(bool)
    cfy = 1.0 / df_copy['pcf_ocf_ttm'].replace(0, np.nan)
    by = 1.0 / df_copy['pb_lf'].replace(0, np.nan)
    lev = df_copy['debttoassets'] / 100.0
    health = (1 - lev).clip(lower=0)
    small_val = by * health
    factor = np.where(large, cfy, np.where(small, small_val, cfy))
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name='factor_simplified_size_adaptive_value_v2')
